THEY PAVED PARADISE AND PUT UP A SKYWAY

I condemn the DENR for allowing the tree-cutting and earth-balling of HUNDREDS OF TREES along Quirino Avenue in Manila City.

All of these trees cut.

Just to pave the way for the construction of the “Southern Access Link Expressway” (SALEX) by San Miguel Corporation.

The SALEX spans a measly 4 kilometers but four elevated lanes.

A total of 617 trees will be affected.

617 trees — all of it for just 4 kilometers of an expressway which will never reduce traffic because all expressways have been proven to actually induce demand for automobiles according to empirical research and scientific studies.

Hundreds of trees have ALREADY been cut but hundreds more will be cut in the next few days.

I call on President Bongbong Marcos, the DENR, SMC, and the City of Manila to stop this madness.

SAVE THE TREES!

🌲🌳🪾

#SaveTheTrees

In line with the government's nationwide 'Oplan Kontra Baha' program, the project involves installing two 1.50-meter-diameter High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) pipes as part of the upgrading and rehabilitation of the existing drainage system.
